pieces.name: Swipe Carousel
pieces.summary: Swipe through a row of image cards that gently settle with your chosen card in the center.

items.type: Array<{id: string, image: string, alt: string, title: string, text: string, cta?: {label: string, href: string}}>
items.description: Required array; stable unique IDs and image alt text. Empty lists are supported. No fixed upper limit. Keep titles and text concise enough to fit the card.

startIndex.description: Initial zero-based card; rounded and clamped. Later changes do not control selection.

options: Any valid CSS width, e.g. 280px, 70vw, or clamp(220px, 70vw, 360px)
cardWidth.description: Capped to carousel width minus 32px. Cards use a 3:4 aspect ratio.

gap.description: Distance between card centers as a share of card width; clamped to range.

sideScale.description: Scale of side cards; clamped to range.

fanOnView.description: Fan out once per mounted carousel when it enters view; scrolling out and back does not replay.

onChange.description: Called once when the selected index changes, including data shrinking; not on initial render or selecting the current card.

label.description: Accessible name for the carousel region, e.g. What’s Inside. Use a distinct name when a page has multiple carousels.

pieces.reducedMotion: useReducedMotion skips the fan-out and all springs. Navigation and content changes are instant; direct dragging and all controls remain available.
